Under the locked defaults (all 276 rows, '-77' excluded column-wise, literal '0' treated as missing for Q1_ML_Life_Cycle_Importance_Problem_Understanding, seed 42, B=10,000 percentile bootstrap), the two roles with the highest proportion of association with requirements in ML-enabled systems are, in rank order, Project Lead / Project Manager (Q8 quoted in 99 of 194 respondents = 51.031 percent; 95 percent bootstrap CI [43.814, 58.247]) and Data Scientist (95 of 194 = 48.969 percent; 95 percent bootstrap CI [41.753, 56.186]); the published lower reference value 49.6 percent [49.219, 49.981] falls between these two point estimates, sits 0.63 pp closer to our Data_Scientist estimate than to our Project_Lead estimate, and lies inside the bootstrap CI of both top roles, while the published upper reference value 61.389 percent [60.955, 61.822] is not reproduced under Definition A, B, or C, with the largest role proportion obtainable across all three definitions being Project Lead / Project Manager at 54.913 percent under Definition C.

Workflow. Cohort: all 276 rows retained, no upfront filtering. Status partition after exclusions inside the operationalisations: Completed (31)=164, Completed after break (32)=24, Suspended (22)=88. Sentinel handling: Q8_ML_Addressing_<role> literal strings 'quoted' / 'not quoted' / '-77' mapped to {1, 0, missing}, with '-77' excluded column-wise from that role's denominator; Q1_ML_Life_Cycle_Importance_Problem_Understanding five-point Likert kept as-is (Not Relevant at All, Low Relevance, Neutral, High Relevance, Extremely Relevant) and both '-77' and the literal string '0' treated as missing for Definitions B and C. Three operationalisations scored per role: A — proportion of Q8 cited alone on the Q8-valid cohort; B — proportion of Q8 cited AND Q1_PR in {High Relevance, Extremely Relevant}; C — same with Q1_PR in {High Relevance, Extremely Relevant, Neutral}. Bootstrap: numpy default_rng(42), B=10,000, sample size equal to the eligible cohort, percentile method (2.5th-97.5th percentile of bootstrapped proportions). Ranking: per-role point estimate descending; tie-break by lower CI bound. Artifact: scripts/results.json contains the full per-role numbers, CIs, plus cohort and encoding summary.
